mechanism: Piperacillin tazobactam (beta-lactam) inactivates aminoglycosides (amikacin) in vitro and in vivo, reducing aminoglycoside efficacy, particularly in patients with renal impairment where drug concentrations remain elevated.
action: Administer piperacillin tazobactam and amikacin at separate sites with staggered infusion times; monitor amikacin levels and renal function closely; consider alternative agents if synergistic coverage is required for extended durations.
